A broad overview of administrative, front office, and clerical job listings has been compiled for Cheyenne, Wyoming, and nearby communities including Laramie, Fort Collins, and Timnath. The listings reflect openings across various industries such as municipal government, healthcare, construction, accounting, and corporate services.

Overview of Available Roles

The listings feature multiple administrative and support positions. Confirmed roles appearing in the regional data include:

  • State and Local Government: Office Assistant I and Office Support Specialist II with the State of Wyoming in Cheyenne; Inmate Program Coordinator and District Court Specialist with Laramie County Government; Human Resources Specialist (Part-Time) and City Clerk Administrative Assistant (Part-Time) with the City of Cheyenne; and Title Services Clerk with the State of Colorado in Larimer County.
  • Accounting and Professional Services: Front Desk Administrative Assistant at RLR, LLP Certified Public Accountants & Advisors in Cheyenne; Administrative Assistant/Client Coordinator at Ascend in Cheyenne; and Branch Office Administrator roles at Edward Jones in Laramie and Fort Collins.
  • Construction and Infrastructure: Construction Administrative Assistant with CEC in Cheyenne; Administrative Assistant with Michels Corporation in Cheyenne and Laramie; Project Coordinator with JE Dunn Construction in Cheyenne and Fort Collins; and Subcontracts Administrative Assistant with Bechtel Corporation in Cheyenne.
  • Healthcare and Medical Support: Remote Medical Support Assistant at Ansible Government Solutions in Cheyenne; Patient Services Representative at Weil Foot & Ankle Institute in Cheyenne; Patient Financial Services Representative positions with Banner Health in Fort Collins and Timnath; and Patient Access Specialist Sr with UCHealth in Fort Collins.

Practical Implications and Analysis

Job seekers exploring the regional administrative market will find opportunities spanning multiple sectors, allowing candidates to target specific work environments ranging from public agencies to private medical and construction firms. Because these listings originate from a broader aggregation, application requirements, deadlines, and compensation packages vary significantly by employer.

Readers should note that specific details—including exact salaries, application deadlines, eligibility criteria, and formal selection processes—are not specified in the aggregated source data and must be verified directly through each hiring organization.

What Is Confirmed Versus Unknown

  • Confirmed: A multitude of administrative, clerical, client coordinator, and project assistant positions are currently active or recently posted across Cheyenne, WY, and surrounding areas like Fort Collins and Laramie, involving employers such as the State of Wyoming, Bechtel Corporation, Edward Jones, and Banner Health.
  • Unknown: Individual salaries, application closing dates, specific educational or experience eligibility prerequisites, and detailed hiring steps are not provided in the source text.
